order_levels

//! Levels, reach, and seen order.

MACROS: none

Public surface

  • Able
  • Config

Level 1: top-level types

Run

/// The main entry: it reaches the most declarations.
struct Run
{
    config: Config,

    steps: Vec<Step>,
}

Able

/// A root that ties Report on reach and comes first by path.
struct Able
{
    leaf: Leaf,
}

Report

/// A root that ties Able on reach.
struct Report
{
    summary: Summary,
}

Level 2

Step

/// Named by Run; first names Trace, then Log.
struct Step
{
    a_trace: Trace,

    b_log: Log,

    config: Config,
}

Leaf

/// Named only by Able.
struct Leaf;

Summary

/// Named only by Report.
struct Summary;

Level 3

Config

/// Named by Run at level 1 and by Step at level 2, so it lands at level 3.
struct Config
{
    limit: u32,
}

Trace

/// Named only by Step, before Log.
struct Trace;

Log

/// Named only by Step.
struct Log;

Unconnected types

Orphan

/// Names nothing and nothing names it.
struct Orphan;
